purpose: Implement a complete Julia bounded fitting job for the actual common thirteen-parameter prepared prediction/profile interface; retain the separate real-data admission requirement.
numerical_owner: Julia constructs and owns each NLopt Opt and its Julia objective callback. No Python callback, language-model call, native HOPPET context or provider query enters optimization. Native preparation closes before fitting.
algorithm: LN_SBPLX via the registered NLopt Julia package and native artifact pinned in numerics/Manifest.toml. This is deterministic local derivative-free optimization, not a global-optimum certificate.

coordinates.domain: Nh_u,Nh_d in closed [-1,1]; a_u,a_d,b_u,b_d,alpha_u,alpha_d,beta_u,beta_d >=0; Nc_u,Nc_d unbounded; gc<fixed gh. Every iterate and returned candidate must also pass KPSYParameters.
coordinates.binary64_gc_upper: prevfloat(gh), the largest representable allowed binary64 value; this does not introduce a new continuous physical bound
coordinates.no_surrogate_bounds: No tanh/exp reparameterization, arbitrary finite shape/Collins bounds, clamp, penalty value or fabricated boundary gradient
coordinates.singular_derivatives: The transversity peak-normalization derivatives at a_u,a_d,b_u,b_d=0 are unsupported. Derivative-free optimization must retain finite objective evaluations there. This does not assert singularity of the unnormalized Collins alpha/beta derivatives.

settings.time_limit: Optional operational resource limit only; no wall-clock performance acceptance claim
settings.settings_ownership: Own finite fixed positive step/tolerance vectors and explicit start vectors; reject Bool, fitted settings, nonfinite or out-of-domain starts before any fit

termination.rules: A positive NLopt return code alone is insufficient. Budget/time exhaustion is INCOMPLETE; negative/unknown codes or callback/source failures are FAIL. Every requested start is retained. Overall PASS requires all requested starts to reach configured tolerance stops and pass independent finite/bounds/objective/source checks. No returned candidate proves global optimality, experimental accuracy or inference coverage.
termination.failure: Do not replace invalid objective evaluations with Inf, a penalty or a synthetic fallback. Retain error, evaluation count and any finite candidate; abort that start and keep overall FAIL. A failed start is never silently dropped.
termination.audit: Re-evaluate reported candidate objective in Julia; verify bounds, all supplied starts, callback/evaluation accounting, unmodified likelihood and current source/dependency receipts. Retain evaluation theta/chi2 traces when requested.

validation.quadratic: Independent diagonal 13-dimensional quadratics with known interior and active closed-boundary optima, including zero transversity shapes and large unbounded Collins normalizations; objective and coordinate errors <=1e-5
resource_and_failure_controls: each supplied start and its stop remains visible
validation.sign_branch: Compare to the supplied truth and its simultaneous Nh_u/Nh_d/Nc_u/Nc_d sign flip. Never canonicalize the fitted sign or claim a lattice sign constraint.
validation.identifiability: Require more observations than thirteen parameters and full local rank of the covariance-whitened prediction Jacobian at the interior truth, with relative singular-value threshold 1e-10. Retain singular values. This is local information, not global identifiability or coverage.
validation.independent_profile: Recompute the best candidate using the existing independent augmented least-squares QR reference; inherit its algebra 1e-11/relative-floor 1e-8 policy unchanged.

geometry.STAR: 200/510 GeV, jT=0.2/0.4 at the existing explicitly synthetic three-node geometry; quark-only, fixed z=0.3, pT=20, eta=0.3, R=0.6, standard axis and historical_pT_C11
geometry.enumeration: SIDIS cartesian x,z,charge (24), alternating Q2/P by index; SIA cartesian z1,z2,ratio (24), alternating Q2/P by index; four STAR point observations, total 52. No physical acceptance or bin edges are inferred.

validation.observations: Noiseless t(truth). Explicit synthetic C_ij=sigma_i*sigma_j*0.2^abs(i-j), sigma_i=0.002+0.00001*i; A_ij=0.0001*sin(i*j), R_ij=0.01*cos(0.3*i+j); S=[[1,0.35],[0.35,1.4]]. No experimental nuisance is inferred.
validation.boundary_path: A separate physical-family zero-shape/closed-Nh initial evaluation with a deliberately one-evaluation budget verifies finite direct-coordinate behavior and retained INCOMPLETE status; it is not parameter recovery or a coverage test.
validation.scope: The current eight-point fixture is not used as evidence of thirteen-parameter recovery. All 52-observation fitting evidence remains synthetic; pinned physical inputs require a separately frozen preparation job before claiming that path.

limitations: No experimental or historical candidate is admitted by this optimizer
No original MINUIT bounds or unrounded optimum are recovered
No replica/interval coverage, marginalized posterior, full-x lattice moment or new extraction is established
Production data/acceptance/covariance/overlap and the failed original paper-center benchmarks remain unresolved
A solver tolerance stop and a finite synthetic closure cannot authorize production or certify global optimality
